import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { compute } from "./calc";
import { MAX_EXPRESSION_LENGTH } from "./data";
import type { AppProps } from "./types";

const OPERATORS = ["+", "-", "×", "÷"];

interface CalcKey {
  label: string;
  kind: "num" | "op" | "clear" | "back" | "equals";
  span?: number;
  rowSpan?: number;
}

const KEYS: CalcKey[] = [
  { label: "C", kind: "clear" },
  { label: "⌫", kind: "back" },
  { label: "÷", kind: "op" },
  { label: "×", kind: "op" },
  { label: "7", kind: "num" },
  { label: "8", kind: "num" },
  { label: "9", kind: "num" },
  { label: "-", kind: "op" },
  { label: "4", kind: "num" },
  { label: "5", kind: "num" },
  { label: "6", kind: "num" },
  { label: "+", kind: "op" },
  { label: "1", kind: "num" },
  { label: "2", kind: "num" },
  { label: "3", kind: "num" },
  { label: "=", kind: "equals", rowSpan: 2 },
  { label: "0", kind: "num", span: 2 },
  { label: ".", kind: "num" },
];

function lastOperand(expression: string): string {
  const parts = expression.split(/[+\-×÷]/);
  return parts[parts.length - 1] ?? "";
}

export default function App(_props: AppProps) {
  const [expression, setExpression] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const preview = useMemo(() => {
    if (!expression) return "";
    const outcome = compute(expression);
    if (outcome.ok) {
      return outcome.display;
    }
    return "";
  }, [expression]);

  function handleKey(key: string) {
    setError(null);

    if (key === "C") {
      setExpression("");
      setAnswer(null);
      return;
    }

    if (key === "⌫") {
      setAnswer(null);
      setExpression((prev) => prev.slice(0, -1));
      return;
    }

    if (key === "=") {
      if (!expression) return;
      const outcome = compute(expression);
      if (outcome.ok) {
        setExpression(outcome.display);
        setAnswer(outcome.display);
      } else {
        setAnswer(null);
        setError(outcome.error);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (OPERATORS.indexOf(key) !== -1) {
      setAnswer(null);
      setExpression((prev) => {
        if (!prev) return key === "-" ? "-" : prev;
        const last = prev.slice(-1);
        if (OPERATORS.indexOf(last) !== -1) return prev.slice(0, -1) + key;
        if (last === ".") return prev.slice(0, -1) + key;
        return prev + key;
      });
      return;
    }

    // digits and decimal point
    setAnswer(null);
    setExpression((prev) => {
      if (prev.length >= MAX_EXPRESSION_LENGTH) return prev;

      const operand = lastOperand(prev);

      if (key === ".") {
        if (operand.indexOf(".") !== -1) return prev;
        if (operand === "") return prev + "0.";
        return prev + ".";
      }

      if (operand === "0") return prev.slice(0, -1) + key;
      return prev + key;
    });
  }

  const shownExpression = expression || "0";
  const shownResult = error ? "" : preview || answer || "";

  return (
    <div className="calc-app">
      <header className="calc-header">
        <h1 className="calc-title">Calculator</h1>
        <p className="calc-subtitle">Fast, offline and ad-free</p>
      </header>

      <div className="calc-shell">
        <div className="calc-display" role="status" aria-live="polite">
          <div className="calc-expression">{shownExpression}</div>
          {error ? (
            <div className="calc-error" role="alert">
              {error}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="calc-result">{shownResult}</div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="calc-keys">
          {KEYS.map((key, index) => {
            const style: { gridColumn?: string; gridRow?: string } = {};
            if (key.span) style.gridColumn = `span ${key.span}`;
            if (key.rowSpan) style.gridRow = `span ${key.rowSpan}`;

            const classNames = ["calc-key", key.kind].join(" ");

            return (
              <button
                key={`${key.label}-${index}`}
                type="button"
                className={classNames}
                style={style}
                onClick={() => handleKey(key.label)}
                aria-label={
                  key.kind === "clear"
                    ? "Clear"
                    : key.kind === "back"
                      ? "Delete last character"
                      : key.kind === "equals"
                        ? "Equals"
                        : key.label
                }
              >
                {key.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <p className="calc-hint">
          {MAX_EXPRESSION_LENGTH} characters max per expression
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
